hero.title: Raffles University
hero.summary: Raffles University’s School of Agricultural Sciences offers an eight-semester agriculture degree in Neemrana. Its teaching account connects crop and animal sciences with economics, farm practicals, rural work experience and industry attachment. A dedicated agriculture library is also linked from the university site.

overview.heading: Agricultural study linking field science and farm decisions
paragraphs: The Raffles agriculture course includes crop production and protection, plant breeding, soils, water management and agricultural economics. Teaching is described through lectures, seminars and practical work in laboratories and farms. The school also identifies departments spanning animal science, dairy, poultry, agricultural engineering and agrometeorology.

Rural Agricultural Work Experience and Agro-Industrial Attachment are part of the school’s stated educational model. These activities connect students with farmers’ fields and industry settings. The dated 2026-27 charge sheet separately identifies annual academic fees, one-time joining charges and optional accommodation costs, allowing applicants to distinguish study costs from their living budget.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: The programme combines agricultural science, farm practicals and a final-year hands-on component.
programmes.eligibility: Undated official course page: 10+2 Science/Agriculture with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics/Biology/Agriculture, at least 50% aggregate.

fees.includes: Published tuition/course fee; additional charges must be checked separately.
fees.note: Annual academic fee. One-time registration INR 1,000, admission INR 9,000 and refundable academic security INR 5,000 separately; hostel charges excluded.

programmes.icar_scope_note: Only the programme labels reproduced in the ICAR accreditation section are supported by the audited register; additional offerings are not automatically included.

admissions.heading: Planning an agriculture application
admissions.intro: The university has a general application and assessment procedure, while its 2023 agriculture self-study compliance report refers to the Rajasthan JET schedule. Obtain the current agriculture-specific route before following the general Situation Test and interview process.

steps.title: Confirm the course
steps.text: Use the official programme contact to confirm that the listed degree is taking applications for your intended intake.

steps.title: Request the intake notice
steps.text: Ask for the applicable selection rules, fee breakdown and document checklist before submitting an application.

documents: Academic certificates appropriate to the course.

campus.heading: Laboratories, rural work and industry attachment
campus.intro: The school names subject laboratories across crop, soil, animal and allied fields. Its RAWE and industry-attachment account describes work outside the classroom with farm and industry communities.

facilities.name: Agricultural subject laboratories
facilities.description: The school identifies laboratories including soils, plant health and crop improvement.

practical_learning: Rural Agricultural Work Experience and Agro-Industrial Attachment are described by the school.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: The university FAQ says the Gomber Education Foundation considers scholarship and fee concessions case by case, subject to merit, need and available funds. An agriculture-specific current award amount was not verified.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The school names individual alumni employers, including Dhanuka Agritech and Mondew Agri Science. These examples are not a dated placement rate, typical salary or promise to a future cohort.

recognition.heading: Recognition and programme accreditation
recognition.text: ICAR lists Raffles University, Neemrana, Alwar, Rajasthan for 2024-06-20 to 2029-06-19. The exact degree labels appear below. Printed intake belongs to the accreditation record and does not establish current admission seat availability.

faqs.question: How long is Raffles’ agriculture course?
faqs.answer: The programme table lists four years and eight semesters.

faqs.question: What practical attachment model does the school describe?
faqs.answer: It names Rural Agricultural Work Experience and Agro-Industrial Attachment.

faqs.question: What is Raffles’ agriculture academic fee for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The signed 2026-27 sheet lists INR 65,000 per year. Registration, admission and refundable security are separate one-time charges; hostel costs are additional.

faqs.question: Are scholarships automatic?
faqs.answer: The university FAQ describes case-by-case consideration by the Gomber Education Foundation, subject to its conditions and available funds.

faqs.question: Should agriculture applicants follow the general Situation Test route?
faqs.answer: The general procedure describes it, but the agriculture compliance report mentions JET scheduling. Confirm the current programme-specific route.
